mechanics_summary: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user advances and sweeps a whirlwind-like breath/ki wave from left to right, dealing a documented 30% damage across one hit and ending in a pose. The attack cannot be blocked; Majuub's variant can also paralyze an opponent caught during its initial startup. Exact startup and current damage scaling remain unresolved.
